decisions.statement: Entries before the first tool call awaiting a result are settled.
A settled entry is drawn once and appended.
The entries after the settled ones are drawn again on every read.
Both slices are drawn against one read.
A read that folded nothing anywhere leaves the panel as that panel is.
A file folded from its first byte starts the panel over.
A transcript that rotated starts the panel over.
One read is in flight at a time.
A write arriving mid-read is read for once that read finishes.
The panel reads when a file the panel is fed by is written and at no other time.
The folder with a transcript is watched rather than the transcript.
One watcher on that folder catches an append and a rotation alike.
The folder a transcript's subagents sit in is watched as well.
The transcript's place is asked for once and then only where that place can have moved.
A name moving beside the transcript says the transcript may have moved.
A change naming no file at all is taken as a move that may have happened.
A change under the subagents folder says nothing about where the transcript is.
A folder that is not there yet is watched once the next read finds that folder.
A watcher whose folder went is closed.
The next read watches a folder that went again.
Closing a panel closes every watcher that panel registered.
A disclosure the reader opened stays open when the tail is drawn again.
A disclosure is matched again by the id of the call that disclosure draws.
The view follows the end only while the reader is already at the end.
Being at the end is judged with a tolerance rather than exactly.
The webview runs only the script the shell has a nonce for.
One channel reports every transcript panel's read cost.
No transcript content passes through that channel.
No timer starts a read.

definition: the webview a seat's transcript is drawn into, and what each read draws again
